Subject: Acme Health opportunities — missing amounts & SKU mapping

Marissa,

We ran a checkpoint of our side and noticed several Redwood-linked opportunities in our CRM that are missing dollar amounts, and a couple where the product column says "TBD" even though the contract references specific SKUs. Procurement is pushing to lock ARR for Q1 forecasting this week. Can you help surface: 

- A CSV export of all open Acme-related opportunities (stages: Proposal, Final Review, Commit) with amount, currency, product/SKU, probability, and next step
- Any known reasons why some entries are "TBD" in product

I attached an export we pulled (opportunity_export.csv) — there are about 18 rows that look suspect. Can someone on your side confirm values so our FP&A can model reliably?

Thanks,
Rob Grant
VP, Strategic Accounts
Acme Health

Marissa / team — I pulled the export and ran it against our Revenue Ledger and the contract repo. Quick notes: 

- 5 rows are missing amounts because those opportunities were staged accidentally as "Prospect" during an import; their signed SOWs do include ARR.
- 3 opportunities have product listed as "TBD": two are because the AE selected the parent product line "Inference Platform" instead of the detailed SKU; one is a custom integration that needs a quote (line item missing).
- Probability fields look inconsistent: some have 100% (closed) but stage still shows "Final Review".

Attached is a working mapping (acme_sku_map.xlsx) — includes recommended product codes and suggested next-step text. Action items I’m taking: 
- I’ll correct the stage for the five import-affected rows and push amounts to the ledger (ETA: today EOD).
- Jasmine, please review SKUs and flag anything that needs Ops/Prod to price.

Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. RevOps Analyst | Redwood Inference

-Rob
